proposed_changes.change: Stop emitting one capability_shortfall per invocation for an unchanging environment fact. An absent codex-plugin is a property of the host, not an event that occurred during this audit. Emit on transition (absent when it was previously present, or first observation per host fingerprint), or delegate the disclosure to /qor-enterprise-environment-adapter, which already probes the same capability and owns host posture.
proposed_changes.rationale: Measured: 29 codex-plugin shortfalls across 29 distinct sessions, all severity 2, all emitted by qor-audit -- exactly one per audit run since 2026-07-04. They are 40 percent of the unaddressed backlog and 43 percent of its raw severity. Every one records the same true, unchanging fact. A threshold that means 'process is drifting' is being driven mostly by a host property that has not changed.

proposed_changes.change: A capability shortfall recurs across sessions by nature, so a rule requiring three occurrences inside one session can never see it. Either group capability_shortfall by (event_type, skill, details.capability) without session_id, or add a cross-session recurrence pattern beside the existing per-session one.
proposed_changes.rationale: remediate_read_context.py:27 keys groups on (event_type, skill, session_id), and remediate_pattern_match.py:38-40 fires capability-shortfall aggregation at >= 3 within a group. The codex recurrence is one per session across 29 sessions, so every event forms a group of one and 1 >= 3 is never true. Measured on the live log: 59 groups produced, 10 events classified, and none of the 29. The largest contributor to the threshold is structurally invisible to the mechanism that exists to act on it.

proposed_changes.target: Process-level finding -- the deferral loop is caused, not chosen
proposed_changes.change: Record that the threshold has been declined four times (2026-08-12 x3 for Phases 224/225 and a loop-cap grant, 2026-09-09 for Phase 283) and that the cause is measurable rather than a matter of operator discipline: the number that fires the gate is dominated by a class the gate's own remediation path cannot classify. Fixing emission and grouping is what makes the threshold mean what it claims.
proposed_changes.rationale: Four orchestration_override events name /qor-remediate as the declined route. Treating that as an operator-discipline problem would be wrong: each deferral was individually correct, because working the backlog would not have changed the number that fires.
